claims.text: Progressive plastic deformation in FCC/BCC HEA multilayer coatings under sustained loading is primarily governed by the evolution of dislocation structures at nanoscale interfaces.
Severe lattice distortion in HEA layers produces heterogeneous interfacial stress fields.
Short-range order in HEA layers contributes to heterogeneous interfacial stress fields.
Heterogeneous interfacial stress fields facilitate localized dislocation nucleation.
Heterogeneous interfacial stress fields facilitate dislocation transmission.
Localized dislocation channels accumulate after nucleation and cause progressive plastic deformation.
The proposed initial coating contains alternating nanoscale FCC and BCC HEA layers.
The proposed initial HEA layers have chemically complex, distorted lattices and pre-existing short-range order.
Diffusion and dislocation mobility are activated under the stipulated creep-test temperatures.
Chemical complexity and lattice distortion create localized high-stress regions at FCC/BCC interfaces.
Localized high-stress regions at FCC/BCC interfaces promote dislocation nucleation and channel formation.
Under sustained loading, dislocation channels preferentially develop at FCC/BCC interfaces.
Preferential interfacial dislocation channels accumulate plastic strain and produce progressive plastic deformation.
Dislocation movement in conventional metallic multilayers tends to be more uniform than in the proposed HEA multilayers.
Creep loading will increase the density of localized dislocation channels at interfaces relative to the initial state.
The HEA multilayer will undergo progressive, spatially non-uniform plastic deformation under creep conditions.
Lattice distortion may initially slow deformation.
Once dislocation channels form, plastic flow will accelerate at the interfaces.
Conventional metallic multilayers with lower compositional complexity and lattice distortion exhibit more uniform dislocation distributions.
Conventional metallic multilayers exhibit predictable creep behavior under comparable loading conditions.

contradictions.description: The predicted outcome alternately frames the comparator as the coating's starting state and as a conventional metallic multilayer, so the stated baseline is internally ambiguous.
